summary: First research night for India Maps: added 5 topics (Keralam and every renamed state, three states of November 2000, Bombay's 1960 split, Nagaland Statehood Day, the Vivek Express route), upgraded the straight-line topic to a 14.3M breakout, and filed two fixes for the improver.
why: The feed had 17 open setup topics with no breakout references; the niche scan's top outliers (3,964x, 256x, 18.7x) pointed at routes and neighbours. Kerala was renamed Keralam in Aug 2026, but our map still says Kerala. And generator/reach.py caps local Shorts at 1 a day and 4 in 11, which blocks a channel that is all-India at 2 a day.

findings.title: Reach rule blocks India Maps' second Short a day
findings.detail: reach.py: 1 local Short a day, 4 local in 11, global needs USD. India Maps is all local: proposal im-reach-india-channel (adopt, high).

findings.title: Kerala is officially Keralam (Aug 2026)
findings.detail: Parliament 11-12 Aug, assent 18 Aug 2026. Map label fix proposed; the every-renamed-state topic ends on it.
